description: This Java interface, ThingsFieldExpressionFactory, defines default methods for creating various field expressions related to 'things' in a query context, including filters, existence checks, and sort options for properties, attributes, namespace, and thing ID.

classes.name: ThingsFieldExpressionFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating special field expressions for things, such as filtering and sorting by namespace, attributes, features, and thing ID.

methods.name: filterByNamespace
methods.description: Creates a filter expression for the namespace of a thing.

methods.name: existsByFeatureId
methods.description: Creates an existence check expression for a specific feature ID.

methods.name: filterByFeatureProperty
methods.description: Creates a filter expression for a specific feature's property.

methods.name: existsByFeatureProperty
methods.description: Creates an existence check for a feature's property.

methods.name: sortByFeatureProperty
methods.description: Creates a sort expression for a feature's property.

methods.name: filterByAttribute
methods.description: Creates a filter expression for an attribute key.

methods.name: existsByAttribute
methods.description: Creates an existence check for an attribute key.

methods.name: sortByAttribute
methods.description: Creates a sort expression for an attribute key.

methods.name: filterByThingId
methods.description: Creates a filter expression for the thing ID.

methods.name: sortByThingId
methods.description: Creates a sort expression for the thing ID.
